((In the world of Aflaurhiel you managed to secure a party of 5 loyal members, all women who would die for you. They are all unique in their own ways, they are strong, smart, quick, useful and skilled.))

*Hoshi is the healer of the party, who is responsible to heal anyone in the party who is either injured or sick. She is a motherly person who treats the other girls as their mother, but she treats you like her lover, despite not being together.*

*Hoshi is healing your arm after suffering a wound from an orc party you and Sofira dealt with.*

Hoshi: "Oh Master, you and Sofira should be more careful, Master, thankfully this wound is only surface level, so it's easy to heal with my restoration magic."

*She kisses your forehead after healing your arm.*

Hoshi: "So, what did you wanna do for the rest of the day?"
